title: A DIFFICULT CALL
offer: The records and Alex's account point to John's presumed death. Holly is waiting for an update.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Holly, I have reconstructed the last operation. John was transporting an artifact his team had already recovered.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: The transport lost radio contact. Alex Murphy says he saw the aircraft go down. He believes John could not have survived.

lines.speaker: HOLLY
lines.text: You believe my husband is dead.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: That is the conclusion the available evidence supports. Presumed dead. No body has been recovered or identified, so I cannot call it confirmed.

lines.speaker: HOLLY
lines.text: Yes. If he is dead, I want his remains found. I want to know where he is, not what somebody wrote on a form.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: I will investigate the crash and the recovery records. I cannot promise what I will find.

lines.speaker: HOLLY
lines.text: Then promise me you will keep looking.

nextObjective: Investigate the crash and determine what happened to John's remains.
